villager.dialogue.traveller.quest.stay_a: I'm looking for a place to spend the night. I've come a long way on my travels, and I must say I'm rather tired.
Wouldn't you perhaps have a spare bed around here? You would have my many thanks.
Sorry, but we aren't catering to newcomers at the moment.
villager.dialogue.quest.migrant_worker.m: %s has joined your settlement as a permanent resident.
villager.dialogue.traveller.quest.valida: You don't have a settlement yet. Establish one by building a Town Hall
Build a %s for this villager to stay in.
This villager is already part of a settlement.
Excuse me, are you the overseer of this outpost? I've just arrived after a long journey.
My governor's map certainly showed this location to be closer, that's for sure...
I'd love to introduce myself and tell you more about why I've come all this way to visit -
- but it's been a few days since I had a proper meal!
Might you be able to provide me with something nice to eat? I can pay you for the meal.
I'll see what food I can find...
Sorry, I can't help right now.
Raw beetroot certainly leaves something to be desired.
Another roadside inn, another meal that makes me miss plain dirt.
Villager's food tests the very definition of 'edible'.
I've traveled these lands far and wide. I now know that every suspicious stew tastes the same.
To serve the meal, right click this villager with a food item.
Thank you so much! That was most delicious.
As promised - here are a few coins to cover the cost!
I certainly appreciate your humble hospitality.

My name is %s, distinguished diplomat and political advisor.

I am emissary of the nearby Kingdom of Brightwater.
I have been sent on a mission to seek out new diplomatic opportunities, particularly with respect to trade and investment in the development of nearby settlements.
You see, my government recognizes that it is in our best interests to support the development of fledgling towns and centers of commerce.
We've considered many locations in which such opportunities seem to have good prospects. You see, we never know when friends of ours can lend us a powerful helping hand in the future!
- Might I add - given its position and reputation, this outpost certainly looks quite promising!
Have you ever considered that this region could attract foreign travellers and workers looking to settle down in a land of new opportunities?
With the right skills, it could even develop into a large settlement with its own self-sufficient workforce!
And of course, with that also comes great possibility for the acquisition of wealth, resources, and power for everyone involved!

Only sophisticated investors truly understand where the real opportunities lie.

Are you one of them?
If you are interested in learning more about what it takes to turn this outpost into a lively town, I can certainly offer my expertise...
... however, I don't plan to stay here long - not more than a few days.
Opportunity awaits the both of us.
villager.dialogue.quest.migrant_worker.f: Well, hello there, stranger. You look like you've walked a good mile.
Certainly! My boots have seen every trail from here to the coast.
What brings you to our humble establishment?

I noticed this town passing by on my way down South.

Quite pleasant here, is it not? Rather nice climate.
Yes, it is rather nice here...
And good soil for growing crops, wouldn't you say?
I suppose this season's harvest has been rather good... Why do you ask?
Well, I'm a farmer by trade. I grew up on my family farm not far from here, although I recently departed them.
Yes - I'm an adult now, and am looking to start my own homestead. I shouldn't want to live with my parents forever.
If you don't mind me asking - do you have any suitable land for agriculture around here?

It definitely looks like this town could use a hand with food provision that's a for sure.

I'm sure I can help with that.
We could sure use some extra hands with farming around here.
villager.dialogue.quest.migrant_worker.m: This villager will join your settlement as a %s.
Build at least one available %s for this villager to live in.
villager.dialogue.quest.migrant_worker.f: Sorry, but we don't have any land available right now...
I can just imagine the delicious produce I'll be able to grow - I'm sure it will fetch a few coins at the next market.
villager.dialogue.quest.migrant_worker.w: A good day to you too.
If only my legs were as strong as my arms, they'd have carried me here in one piece.
I'm a skilled lumberman by trade. There's not a single stripped log that can't be broken with these mighty hands.
You certainly look very strong... what brings you here to these parts?
Oh, just looking for work. The forests haven't been quite what they used to be where I come from...

... That being set, gov', I'd be willing to offer my services in exchange for a permanent place to stay.

This looks like a decent place to call home - and besides, the houses around here could do with some work.
I suppose we could do with some renovations around here.
We aren't in need of any extra labour right now.

Well, I'm off to settle in.

Tomorrow I'll be right at work first thing.
